name: agent-type-advisor
description: Recommend whether a plugin capability should be a markdown (LLM-interpreted) unit or a deterministic script. Use when designing a new agent/skill ("should this be markdown or a script?"), or when auditing an existing agent/skill file for a type mismatch. Accepts either a prose use-case description (forward- looking, new unit) or a path to an existing agent/skill file (retrospective).
